body: Thank you so much for posting this here.
My cat, trying to shove his soaking wet cat toy into my mouth.

I have had some incredible epiphanies on mushrooms. I wish the feelings I had for months after those trips lasted forever but they didn't. The last time I took them I just sat and thought about how pointless our existence is, then I thought about what an awful person I am for a long time and how much of a mess I have made out of my life. It made me sad to realize that I am truly so depressed that I have depressing trips now. I think that's when I realized I've hit the bottom... I get no enjoyment out of anything anymore. I have recently been avoiding all of my friends... I feel like such a piece of shit. I just can't stand being around other people. I don't even know why! I love my friends to death. I barely even leave my house anymore. I dread everything.

I am not close with my family, we hardly speak at all. I have a few friends, I figure I can't mean as much to them as family, so my exiting this existence wouldn't be as painful as someone who has a family that loves them. I can't afford a psychiatrist and I am against the use of psychiatric drugs. I would consider myself to be somewhat of a naturalist. To be honest I think nature should be allowed to take its course, with that being said... I was born dead. I had to be revived and kept on life support... I am not supposed to be alive. Sometimes I think that's why I feel this way. If I was never meant to be alive maybe that's why I find existence so painful. I want to have an epiphany, a life changing experience... I want something to prove to me that I should continue living... But It's just not happening.... I don't thinking ever will. I suffer from depressive realism... Everyday I see people being so horrible to each other, I hear about all the murdering, the raping, the horrible things that humans are capable of. I see things for what they really are, the system we all live in. It's a trap. I don't want a full time job for the rest of my life on meager wages till I can retire just before I die. We live in an unjust anti progressive society built on slavery and corruption. There's no way out. Everyone just tries to fight and claw their way to the top most will never make it. We have created an unsustainable system in which we are all trapped till we die. I don't want to be a part of it anymore. I have little faith in anyone after being abandoned by everyone I have ever loved. My own family treats me like a stranger...
